in_sanskrit.name: रुचिरन्

in_marathi.name: Ruchiran
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ruchiran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'ruc' meaning light or radiance and 'irana' meaning going or moving. It implies someone who is radiant or shining.
